description: Source code implementing a function to prune no-op nodes (empty declarations and literal statements) from an abstract syntax tree in a shader compiler project, specifically for the ANGLE project.

classes.name: PruneNoOpsTraverser
classes.description: A class inheriting from TIntermTraverser that implements traversal logic to remove no-op nodes such as empty declarations and literal statements from the AST.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method to apply the pruning traversal on the AST root.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Handles visiting declaration nodes to prune empty or invalid declarations.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Handles visiting block nodes to remove no-op statements.

methods.name: visitLoop
methods.description: Handles visiting loop nodes to remove no-op expressions or initializations.
